description: Photos aériennes 2012 des plages de Charente-Maritime is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Pôle Odatis. Photos aériennes 2012 des plages de Charente-Maritime réalisées pour l'Observatoire des Pratiques de Tourisme et de Loisir - ECOP (Évolution des CÔtes et des Pratiques ) qui est une unité de la Fédération de Recherche en Environnement pour le Développement Durable (FR 3097). Coverage: Pôle Odatis. The portal shows the English title as "2012 aerial photos of the beaches of Charente-Maritime" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Pôle Odatis. Its keywords include Ortho-imagerie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
